comment_experiment: V20 baseline + inventory suppression + directional flow (threshold 0.3) + flow-weighted quote sizing. After the binary threshold suppresses the inventory-increasing side, the remaining side is continuously scaled by flow magnitude: remaining_scale = max(0, 1 - |flow_imbalance| * weight). At weight=1.0, flow_imbalance=1.0 zeroes the remaining side. Same captures, fees, hard inventory cap, and existing toxicity filter.
